segments.mil7.5.6:1.1: “Bhante nāgasena,‘jarasiṅgālassa dve aṅgāni gahetabbānī’ti yaṃ vadesi, katamāni tāni dve aṅgāni gahetabbānī”ti?
segments.mil7.5.6:1.2: “Yathā, mahārāja, jarasiṅgālo bhojanaṃ paṭilabhitvā ajigucchamāno yāvadatthaṃ āharayati, evameva kho, mahārāja, yoginā yogāvacarena bhojanaṃ paṭilabhitvā ajigucchamānena sarīrayāpanamattameva paribhuñjitabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.5.6:1.4: Idaṃ, mahārāja, jarasiṅgālassa paṭhamaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.5.6:2.3: Bhuñjantaṃ purisaṃ kuṭṭhiṃ, sakkacca naṃ upaṭṭhahiṃ.
segments.mil7.5.6:4.3: Bhuñjamāne vā bhutte vā, jegucchaṃ me na vijjatī’ti.
segments.mil7.5.6:5.1: “Puna caparaṃ, mahārāja, jarasiṅgālo bhojanaṃ paṭilabhitvā na vicināti lūkhaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vāti, evameva kho, mahārāja, yoginā yogāvacarena bhojanaṃ paṭilabhitvā na vicinitabbaṃ ‘lūkhaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā sampannaṃ vā asampannaṃ vā’ti, yathāladdhena santussitabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.5.6:5.3: Idaṃ, mahārāja, jarasiṅgālassa dutiyaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.5.6:6.1: “‘Lūkhenapi ca santusse, nāññaṃ patthe rasaṃ bahuṃ;
segments.mil7.5.6:6.3: Rasesu anugiddhassa, jhāne na ramate [ramatī (sī. pī.)] mano;
